metadata.title: Interaction of Recoiling Supermassive Black Holes with Stars in Galactic Nuclei

notes: No eligible stars. The paper simulates stellar particles around recoiling supermassive black holes and does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The “unbound stars” discussed in T:p12-b1 and T:p16-b2 are unbound from the recoiling SMBH, not from the Milky Way; the possible escape discussed in T:p3-b2 concerns the SMBH escaping its host galaxy, not a star meeting the Galactic-unbound criterion.
